source: Valhalla verbal alert and pre-transition instructions, OpenMapX production, driving

keep.example: Keep left to stay on A 100.

your.example: Your destination will be on the right.

drive.example: Drive northeast. Then Turn right onto Alexanderstraße.

you.example: You will arrive at your destination.

enter.example: Enter Kottbusser Tor and take the 3rd exit onto Adalbertstraße.

make.example: Make a sharp left onto Reeperbahn.

exit.example: Exit the roundabout onto Adalbertstraße. Then You will arrive at your destination.

stay.example: Stay straight to take the A 14 ramp.
